title: Widening onto a check's files
situation: Record corrections, 2026-10-13: an independent architect read the design record cold and found settled decisions contradicting the current design, terms used but never defined, and concepts that disagree; the operator asked for the corrections to be applied. Decision 0135 no longer matches the current design.
decision: No refusal guards the files a check uses (0143); review sees a work package widened onto them.
consequences: The record now states this as the standing rule.
